summary: The IDF withdrew the 98th Division headquarters from the West Bank after a month-long deployment involving 1,500 counterterrorism operations, 140 arrests, 35 weapons seized, and two soldiers killed near Hebron. Israeli artillery shelled Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon while warplanes dropped thermal balloons over Nabatieh and hostile aircraft intrusions triggered red alerts at Zarit, Shomera, and Tzofar. The Saudi-led coalition destroyed two Houthi ballistic missile launchers in Saada, Yemen, a Houthi missile malfunctioned in Dhamar, and an unexplained explosion occurred in Varamin, Iran.

sections.executive_summary: The IDF withdrew the 98th Division headquarters from the West Bank after a month-long deployment involving 1,500 counterterrorism operations, 140 arrests, 35 weapons seized, and two soldiers killed near Hebron. Israeli artillery shelled Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon while warplanes dropped thermal balloons over Nabatieh and hostile aircraft intrusions triggered red alerts at Zarit, Shomera, and Tzofar. The Saudi-led coalition destroyed two Houthi ballistic missile launchers in Saada, Yemen, a Houthi missile malfunctioned in Dhamar, and an unexplained explosion occurred in Varamin, Iran.

points: An explosion occurred in the residential area of Varamin, Tehran Province, Iran at 15:30 local time (1200Z); the cause remains unclear, and the incident was reported with a 120-second delay via FromIran monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/12135)

The IDF withdrew the 98th Division headquarters from the West Bank after a month-long deployment that began September 25, during which the division commanded the Judea and Etzion regional brigades, conducted 1,500 counterterrorism operations, apprehended 140 suspects, seized 35 weapons, and suffered two soldiers killed in a shooting attack near Hebron; the division is now on standby focusing on readiness. (Source: @manniefabian/59487)

A total of 285 ultra-Orthodox men enlisted in the IDF over the past week, placed in combat support roles, with additional draft days scheduled for November-December including for combat units; the military says induction bases are prepared to accommodate their lifestyle. (Source: @manniefabian/59486)

Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot received the mandate to form a government, stating 74 Knesset members no longer trust the outgoing government, and called for a national emergency government; his party denied reports of negotiations with foreign entities on withdrawal from Lebanon. (Source: @amitsegal/66951, @yediotnews25/137463)

Avigdor Liberman clarified he will not join a government relying on Arab parties, emphasizing his preference for understandings with ultra-Orthodox parties, and stated he is not obsessed with becoming prime minister. (Source: @amitsegal/66942, @amitsegal/66941)

The 98th Division headquarters completed its West Bank deployment after 1,500 operations, 140 arrests, 35 weapons seized, and two soldiers killed near Hebron; the division now returns to standby status. (Source: @manniefabian/59487, @N12chat/234000)
No major Gaza-specific operations reported in the current message set.
Israeli artillery conducted shelling on Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, as indicated by live map updates. (Source: @redlinkleb/52147, @redlinkleb/52146)

Israeli warplanes were repeatedly observed over southern Lebanon, with multiple live map posts indicating flights toward the south. (Source: @redlinkleb/52140, @redlinkleb/52135, @redlinkleb/52142, @redlinkleb/52145)
Hostile aircraft dropped thermal balloons in the airspace over the Nabatieh region of southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/52137)
A hostile aircraft intrusion triggered red alerts at the confrontation line near Zarit, Shomera, and Tzofar in northern Israel. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68573)
The Saudi-led coalition announced the destruction of two Houthi ballistic missile launchers in Saada, Yemen, which were used to attack Riyadh. (Source: @N12chat/233998)
A Houthi missile launched from Dhamar Governorate malfunctioned and fell on Al-Rabaa village in Ans district, terrifying residents. (Source: @shin_persian/12140, @shin_persian/12139)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Israeli military activity in the West Bank and along the Lebanese border, coupled with Houthi missile threats to Saudi Arabia and an unexplained explosion in Iran, indicates a multi-axis escalation risk. The IDF's withdrawal of the 98th Division headquarters may signal a shift to standby posture, but ongoing artillery and air operations in southern Lebanon suggest continued pressure on Hezbollah. The Saudi-led coalition's destruction of Houthi launchers in Saada demonstrates persistent counter-missile efforts, while the Varamin explosion and Dammam emergency warning raise questions about internal security in Iran and Saudi Arabia. The presence of USAF BACN assets at Prince Sultan Air Base underscores ongoing U.S. support for regional air operations. Political instability in Israel, with Eisenkot's mandate and Liberman's positioning, could affect military decision-making.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's civil defense issued an emergency warning for Dammam, reflecting heightened alert status amid Houthi missile threats. The Saudi-led coalition's kinetic action against Houthi launchers in Saada shows a continued willingness to strike preemptively. The UKMTO maritime warning indicates concern for shipping lanes, possibly linked to Houthi maritime attacks. The U.S. designation of the Lebanese consul in Detroit as persona non grata signals diplomatic pressure on Lebanon over historical terrorism ties. Israel's political maneuvering around government formation may delay cohesive security policy, but military operations continue independently.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 98th Division's operational data (1,500 ops, 140 arrests, 35 weapons) provides a measurable baseline for West Bank counterterrorism intensity. The use of thermal balloons by Israeli aircraft over Nabatieh suggests intelligence-gathering or decoy tactics. The Houthi missile malfunction in Dhamar highlights potential reliability issues in their arsenal. The Varamin explosion's unclear cause warrants monitoring for potential sabotage or industrial accident. The USAF BACN deployment at Prince Sultan Air Base enhances coalition communications for possible expanded operations.
